name: UPI / QR Code Fraud
summary: Fraudsters trick victims into scanning QR codes, accepting UPI collect requests, or entering their UPI PIN under the false pretext of receiving payments or refunds.
rules: Remember: UPI PIN is entered ONLY to DEBIT money from your account, NEVER to receive money.
Scanning a QR code always DEBITS money from your account.
Do not trust payment confirmation screenshots sent by unknown buyers on marketplaces like OLX.
initialActionChecklist: Immediately dial 1930 (National Cyber Crime Helpline) to report transaction details for rapid inter-bank freeze.
Note down the exact 12-digit UTR (Unique Transaction Reference) number from your bank SMS or UPI app receipt.
Call your debited bank customer care to report unauthorized debit and request a hotlisting / freeze on netbanking and UPI.
Take clear screenshots of transaction debit messages, UPI app transaction history, and suspect chat history.
Do not accept any further collect requests or click any link sent by the suspect.
evidenceRequired: Screenshot of the UPI transaction details with UTR number and beneficiary VPA
Debit SMS received from the bank showing timestamp and account balance deduction
Screenshots of WhatsApp / OLX / chat logs with the suspect
Bank statement showing the unauthorized debit entry
source: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) UPI Guidelines & MHA I4C
